features.heading: Hosting for Every Customer Segment — One Platform
features.intro: Tiered plans and flexible architecture let you serve first-time SMBs, WordPress users, developers, and agencies from the same white-label platform — with centralized provisioning, SSO, and branded management built in.

cards.title: Secure, Reliable Infrastructure
cards.body: Enterprise-grade data centers, high-availability architecture, and performance SLAs your customers can depend on — backed by 24/7 operations your team never has to staff.

cards.title: Multi-Site Management
cards.body: Purpose-built plans for agencies and developers managing multiple client websites — with virtualized environments, access controls, and per-site usage visibility.

cards.title: CMS & Custom Site Support
cards.body: Host WordPress, Joomla, or custom-built sites. Full control over files, databases, PHP versions, and configurations for technically advanced customers.

cards.title: Integrated Digital Services
cards.body: Domains, SSL, business email, and ecommerce plug directly into the hosting experience. Customers manage everything from one branded dashboard.

cards.title: Automated Provisioning
cards.body: New hosting accounts spin up automatically after purchase. No manual setup, no waiting, no bottleneck on your team — and no delay for your customer.

cards.title: White-Label Control & SSO
cards.body: Your brand, your URL, your pricing, your commercial model. Single sign-on ties hosting to the rest of the products in your platform for a unified experience.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Own the Infrastructure Layer — Without Building It
partnerAdvantage.intro: Hosting anchors your SMB customers on your platform. The longer they host with you, the harder it is to leave — and the more products they layer on top.

items.title: Serve every maturity level
items.body: From first-time SMB website owners to agencies managing dozens of client sites — one hosting platform serves them all under your brand, with the right tier for each segment.

items.title: Drive recurring revenue through tiers and add-ons
items.body: Tiered hosting plans plus bundled domains, SSL, and email create multiple recurring revenue streams from a single customer relationship — with attach rates that compound over time.

items.title: Retain technical customers structurally
items.body: Agencies and developers managing multi-site environments on your platform are deeply embedded. That's structural retention — not just contract retention — and it protects your highest-value accounts.

items.title: Skip the infrastructure investment
items.body: Hostopia provides the data centers, tooling, and operations. You get a white-label platform with automated provisioning, SSO, and centralized management — with zero capital investment in infrastructure.

lifecycleFit.heading: The Infrastructure Foundation for Your Digital Portfolio
lifecycleFit.intro: Hosting sits alongside Website Builder and Website Design — ensuring you can serve every customer segment from first-time SMBs to advanced agencies without sending anyone elsewhere.

steps.title: Build a Brand
steps.body: Domains, logo design, and professional email establish the SMB's identity before the site ever goes live.

steps.title: Get Online
steps.body: Website Builder covers DIY, Website Design covers done-for-me, and Hosting covers the technical and agency customers who need more control.

steps.title: Get Found
steps.body: SEO, directories, and reputation management drive visibility once the site is live and performing.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: Ecommerce, email marketing, and custom development fuel growth on the same infrastructure — with no replatforming required.

lifecycleFit.positioning: Position hosting as an upgrade path for advanced users, a foundation for ecommerce deployments, a natural attach with domains and SSL, and the core infrastructure service for agency and developer segments.
